identity.name: Code change protocol
identity.purpose: Chain a code change through DISCOVER, DEFINE, DEVELOP, DELIVER under the safe-prereg discipline. The DEFINE phase freezes predict, kill, and apoha fields before any diff is written; the DELIVER phase renders the verdict against those frozen fields and opens the pull request only if the predict held.

define.predict: The diff produces <named observable change> in <named file or surface> with <named test> turning green.
define.kill: <Named test> stays red, OR <named other test> turns red, OR the diff touches <named out-of-scope area>.
apoha: Not a refactor of unrelated code
Not a behavioural change to the public API beyond what predict names
Not a test rewrite that weakens existing assertions
